items.text: Would absolutely recommend RoofGard. Rich is a credit to his profession his communication and time keeping is excellent. We had a few issues with the roof and upon Rich’s visual inspection he provided us with a video of the work required which was appreciated…

items.text: Richard quoted for a roof replacement, easy guy to get on with, the works commenced ahead of schedule and were completed in a timely manor. The guys on site just got on with the job, no hassle no dramas.The building inspector came out and praised the quality of the installation…

items.text: Richard and the team stripped and recovered a large single-storey roof. Team arrived when they said they would, worked hard, and did a quality job. Definitely recommended.
